label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rickie Fowler's Health Battle
items.text: Rickie Fowler has battled a serious sinus infection for over two years and plans surgery after the 2026 season, as he enters the Rocket Classic final round tied for third at 12-under.

items.headline: Charley Hull Defends Prank
items.text: LPGA star Charley Hull refuses to apologize for pranking her caddie Adam Woodward with a fake £100,000 scratch ticket, saying it was a joke and he found it funny after it was revealed.

items.headline: Nate Lashley's Rocket Classic Win
items.text: Nate Lashley leads the 2019 Rocket Mortgage Classic by six shots after entering as third alternate, boosting him from 132nd to 40th in FedEx Cup and securing major exemptions.
